sanskrit: tvam agne pramatis tvaṃ pitāsi nas tvaṃ sakhā yujyo 'si jātavedaḥ | tvaṃ viśvavid gātuvit kavir viśvā āśā abhayāḥ santv asme ||
english: You, O Agni, are our wisdom; you are our father; you are our companion and ally, O Jātavedas. You are the all-knowing, the knower of the way, the seer — may all the quarters be free of fear for us.

sanskrit: idaṃ varco agninā dattam āgan bhargo yaśaḥ saha ojo vayo balam | trayastriṃśad yāni vīryāṇi tāny agniḥ pra dadātu me ||
english: This lustre, given by Agni, has come — splendour, glory, vital force, vigour, and strength. May Agni bestow upon me those thirty-three heroic powers.

sanskrit: varca ā dhehi me tanvāṃ saha ojo vayo balam | indriyāya tvā karmaṇe vīryāya prati gṛhṇāmi śataśāradāya ||
english: Place lustre into my body, together with vital force, vigour, and strength. I receive you for the sake of the senses, for action, for heroic power, for a hundred autumns.

sanskrit: ūrje tvā balāya tvā- -ojase sahase tvā | abhibhūyāya tvā rāṣṭrabhṛtyāya pary ūhāmi śataśāradāya ||
english: You for nourishment, you for strength, you for vital force, you for might — I carry you around for the purpose of overcoming, for the sustaining of the kingdom, for a hundred autumns.

sanskrit: ṛtubhiṣ ṭvārtavair āyuṣe varcase tvā | saṃvatsarasya tejasā tena saṃhanu kṛṇmasi ||
english: With the seasons and the seasonal rites — you for long life, you for lustre — with the blazing power of the full year we make you firm and compact.

sanskrit: idam āñjanam ānaje śailūnam ākanikradam | abhi mā cakranda bhaga ṛṣabho vāśitām iva ||
english: With this unguent I have anointed myself — the mountain unguent that bellows aloud. Let Fortune roar toward me as a bull roars at a lowing cow.

sanskrit: aśvaḥ kanikradad yathā pratyaṅ mā bhaga āgamat | tam ahaṃ preṇyā adhi putram ivopastha ādhiṣi ||
english: As a neighing horse approaches head-on, so may Fortune come to me. Him I have placed upon my lap with love, as a son upon one's lap.

sanskrit: akṣyau me madhusaṃkāśe jihvā me madhuvādinī | nasor adhi pramandanaṃ datsu me sāraghaṃ madhu ||
english: My eyes are radiant as honey; my tongue is honey-speaking. Upon my nostrils is delight; in my teeth is the honey of the bee.

sanskrit: madhuman mama nīsanaṃ jaghanaṃ madhuman mama | mām it kila tvaṃ vāvanaḥ śākhāṃ madhumatīm iva ||
english: Honey-sweet is my breath; honey-sweet are my loins. Truly you shall win me, as one wins a honey-laden branch.

sanskrit: pretā jayatā nara ugrā vaḥ santu bāhavaḥ | indro vaḥ śarma yacchatv anādhṛṣyā yathāsatha ||
english: Go forth, conquer, O men — fierce be your arms. May Indra grant you shelter, so that you may be invincible.

sanskrit: ud dharṣantāṃ maghavann āyudhāny ut satvanāṃ māmakānāṃ manāṃsi | ud dharṣantāṃ vājināṃ vājināny ud vīrāṇāṃ jayatām etu ghoṣaḥ ||
english: O Maghavan, let the weapons bristle up; let the spirits of my warriors surge upward. Let the prize-winning powers of the prize-winning steeds surge upward; let the battle-shout of conquering heroes rise on high.

sanskrit: pṛthag ghoṣā ululayaḥ ketumanta ud īratām | devā indrajyeṣṭhā maruto yantu senayā ||
english: Let the diverse battle-cries and the ululations bearing banners be raised aloft. Let the gods with Indra foremost, the Maruts, march forth with the army.

sanskrit: avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahmasaṃśite | jayāmitrān pra padyasva māmīṣāṃ kaṃ canoc chiṣaḥ ||
english: Released, fly forth, O arrow-volley, sharpened by sacred utterance. Fall upon those who are enemies to victory — let not a single one of these escape.
